# MSM known-answer vectors, from ark-bn254's VariableBaseMSM.
#
# msm <pattern> <n> <seed> <expected>
#
# <expected> is 128 hex characters: x || y, each coordinate canonical
# 32-byte little-endian, all-zero for infinity.
#
# Inputs are the deterministic expansion of <seed> through
# test_support::Rng, documented in tools/kat-gen/src/msm.rs and
# reimplemented independently in crates/curve/tests/msm.rs: n bases
# first, then n scalars, each a 32-byte little-endian draw with the
# top two bits cleared and values >= p rejected.
#
# patterns: random | zeros | identical | infinity
